description: Get, set, or delete an entry in an Ensemble lookup table. 'get' returns the value for a key (and whether it exists). 'set' creates or updates a key-value pair. 'delete' removes a key from the table.

namespace.description: Target namespace. Defaults to the server's configured namespace; pass an explicit value to query a different namespace per call without changing the connection default.

server.description: Named server profile to target for this call (from `IRIS_PROFILES`). Omit to use the default server.

name: iris_lookup_manage
title: Manage Lookup Table
